notes.ku-ddyo: “Right” era kitegeeza “kituufu”, naye wano kitegeeza ddyo.

guidebook.intro: Manya ebifo mu kibuga n’ennyumba, gamba gy’ogenda, era olage oba obuuze ekkubo mu Lungereza.

tips.title: “Going to”
body: Mu Luganda ogamba **Ŋŋenda ku ssomero**. Mu Lungereza ogamba **I am going to school**: **to** kiraga gy’ogenda.
Naye ku waka, toteekako **to**: **I am going home.**

culture.title: Bodaboda
body: Ekigambo **boda boda** kiva ku Lungereza “border to border”, kubanga ppikipiki zaasooka okutwala abantu okusala ensalo. Kati kye kigambo kya Uganda n’Olungereza lwaayo.
